verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a meta-framework is one community user's hands-on mention of SolidStart routing, which they say is 'occasionally very slow with no workaround.' First-party material covers only core SSR, streaming and Resources for data loading, not a meta-framework. The slowness report is a quality caveat, not proof that routing fails, so this is partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that SolidStart is the official meta-framework, documented file/route-based routing, documented server data fetching or loaders in the meta-framework, and independent corroboration that it works well.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official full-stack meta-framework built on top of the framework for routing and data fetching

citations.quote: SolidStart routing is occasionally very slow with no workaround
